main_text.head: ORATIO.
main_text.p: Etsi truculentus aspectus, laetitia quam ex miseris nostris aemuli nostri percipiunt, eorumque tum cachinni tum sarcasmi,magnum nobis adferunt, ô Deus iuste,dolore: tamen,oramus te supplicitèr, ne illa omnia eis statuas in peccatum: & ut nobis des, ut malum retaliantes bono, te Patrem cœlestem imitemur. Conuerte etiam ex illis eos, quos tibi visum est ad meliorem mentem & frugem reuocare: ut unà nobiscum tuæ immensæ bonitatis testes & præcones sint. Amen.
main_text.head: VERSVS XIII.
main_text.p: Lectio 9i 2.Martij-biduo ante quam Pa-norim pro-fisciscerer[?] ad Acad. σὺν θεῷ, reform.Neque ingrediaris in portam populi mei die calamitatis eorum, ne aspicias tu quoque malum eius die calamitatis ipsius: neque ex-tendant se (manus) in facultates eius die ca-lamitatis eius.

Secunda dehortationis pars est, quaà vi & à rapinis dehortatur Idumæos.In expugnatione vrbium fit via vi, irrumpunt hostes, primosque trucidant & alios multos iugulant: vbi autem strage ciuium edita, superiores euaserunt, tum vero diripiunt eorum facultates, ἁρπαγαὶ καὶ φθοραί[?], & hoc fit, quod monent versus:

page.notes: Catchword "quippe" is partly cut off at the lower right edge; read as "quippe". Page number printed in decorative form ("9o"), transcribed as 90. The margin note "Pa-norim" and "fisciscerer" are hard to read in the scan; the reading "Patrorum" is not clearly visible, so the letters are given as seen. The Greek in the margin and in the text is only partly legible and is marked [?]. The word "quaà" appears with an accented a and is copied as printed. Long s transcribed as s throughout. Printed "miserijs" read as "miseris" (final vowel i). The ligature "ȝ" in "prȝcones" is read as æ.
